parent_objective: design a no-PPO objective-only update around the exact M1285 source-history residual
blocked_by: M1286 promotes to the source-history objective-only update branch
supersedes: continuing source-intervention materialization branch after synthesis

public_gates: M1287 must preserve actor input contract
M1287 must not use private holdout
M1287 must design objective-only update stages and retention gates
M1287 must keep exact M1285 objective as the first gate
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip exact M1285 loss gate
do not run public replay gates before exact-loss sanity

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the first exact objective-only update branch after source-intervention synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: update design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, closed-loop, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if update would require actor-input expansion
stop if exact M1285 objective cannot be used as first gate
stop if retention planning is missing
fallback_plan: if design is viable, admit a tiny no-PPO objective-only implementation
if design is not viable, route to source-history corpus repair
if retention cannot be specified, route to old-proof anchor design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: new branch opened by M1286 synthesis

admission_evidence: M1286 promotes to objective-only update branch
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next manifest if design admits implementation

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1287 designs an update for same-current-observation source-history residuals but does not evaluate closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future implementation must compare correct-history and wrong-history objective residuals exactly
future result must not infer self-ID from objective loss alone
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1285 exact source-history residual; design only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If exact objective-only update cannot improve without retention risk, record negative evidence and do not start PPO.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A bounded no-PPO objective-only update can be designed around the exact M1285 source-history residual with strict retention guardrails.
success_criteria: design specifies exact M1285 loss gate
design specifies retention and no-PPO guardrails
design admits at most a tiny no-PPO implementation
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design omits exact M1285 loss gate
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1287 passes if it designs a bounded no-PPO objective-only update path with exact-loss and retention gates.
